documents.title_en: Hearthstone Ceramic Studio — Custom Order & Exchange Policy

blocks.text_en:
Thank you for shopping at Hearthstone Ceramic Studio. Standard dinnerware sets purchased from our showroom shelves may be exchanged or returned for a full refund within 30 days of purchase, provided they are unused and accompanied by the original printed receipt.

Please note that custom-monogrammed platters and bespoke restaurant glaze orders require a 40 percent nonrefundable deposit at the time the order is placed. However, if any item arrives with a manufacturing crack or glaze defect, our studio will fire and ship a replacement piece at no cost if you e-mail photographs of the damage to support@hearthstoneceramics.com within 72 hours of delivery.

items.prompt_en: What is required to receive a full refund on a standard dinnerware set?

choices.text_en: Returning the unused items with the original receipt within 30 days
Paying a 40 percent restocking fee at the showroom desk
Submitting photographs of the tableware within 72 hours
Exchanging the set for a bespoke restaurant glaze order

items.prompt_en: Under what circumstance will the studio replace a custom-monogrammed platter free of charge?

choices.text_en: When a customer decides to change the monogram spelling after firing
When the item is delivered with a structural crack and reported with photos within three days
When the order is canceled before the 30-day showroom return window expires
When the buyer visits the showroom in person without a receipt

documents.title_en: Internal Notice: Calibration Shutdown for Packaging Line B

blocks.text_en:
To: All Shift Supervisors, Brno Bottling Facility
From: Marek Horak, Director of Plant Operations
Date: November 4
Subject: Scheduled Laser-Sensor Calibration on Packaging Line B

On Thursday, November 7, Packaging Line B will be taken offline from 1:00 P.M. to 5:00 P.M. so that engineers from Viktoria Optics can calibrate the high-speed fill-level sensors. [[position:1]] Recent quality audits showed a slight variance in bottle fill volumes during peak throughput, and this preventive adjustment will ensure full compliance with European export standards. [[position:2]]

To avoid delaying our Friday shipment to Munich, afternoon bottling runs originally assigned to Line B will be rerouted to Packaging Line A and Packaging Line C. [[position:3]] Those two lines have sufficient reserve capacity to absorb the extra 14,000 units without requiring overtime hours. [[position:4]] Line B operators should report to Conference Room 2B at 1:15 P.M. on Thursday for a two-hour refresher seminar on the updated sensor diagnostic dashboard.

items.prompt_en: Why is Packaging Line B being shut down on Thursday afternoon?

choices.text_en: To adjust optical sensors that measure liquid levels in bottles
To repair a broken conveyor belt damaged during the morning shift
To reduce electricity usage during municipal power maintenance
To install a brand-new labeling machine for domestic orders

items.prompt_en: What is indicated about Friday's shipment to Munich?

choices.text_en: It has been postponed until next Monday morning.
It will require staff to work four hours of paid overtime.
Its production volume will be handled by two other packaging lines.
It will be inspected in Conference Room 2B at 1:15 P.M.
